compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is prompting the user to enable location services. The main contents and functions of this screen include:

1. **Icon**: A location pin icon is displayed at the top center of the screen.
2. **Title**: The text "WHERE ARE YOU?" is prominently displayed below the icon.
3. **Message**: A message below the title informs the user that location services need to be turned on for the application to work properly.
4. **Button**: At the bottom of the screen, there is a yellow button labeled "ENABLE LOCATION" which the user can tap to turn on location services.

The overall purpose of this screen is to request the user to enable location services for the app to function correctly.
